# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## 0.1.0 — 2026-10-09

### 🎉 Features

- Adds the `@williamthorsen/build-info-react` package, whose unstyled `BuildLabel`, `ReleaseNotes`, and `BuildInfoDisplay` components render a `BuildInfo`'s label, commit link, and release notes, and work as both React Server Components and client components because they don't use hooks or context. (#988)
